description: Get one JGP group from the catalog in force on service_date: name, product code, base points per column, scopes, the act and release, its grouping conditions with the directional lists they name, and NFZ monthly settlement statistics (settled points, not catalog). Pass a list's id and catalog to get_jgp_list; use compare_jgp_group for changes between dates.

service_date.description: Day of care, YYYY-MM-DD; picks the release in force. Default today in Poland.

name: get_jgp_group

outputSchema.description: A JGP or grouping answer of the HTTP API, with the notice.

title: JGP group
